headline: Asian Economies Expand Nuclear Energy Push Amid Strait of Hormuz Risks
summary: Asian nations committed to accelerating nuclear power expansion at the COP31 summit as Middle East military conflict and shipping threats in the Strait of Hormuz exposed severe oil and LNG vulnerabilities.
why: Disruptions to Persian Gulf maritime energy transit compel import-dependent Asian manufacturing hubs to diversify into baseload nuclear power generation.

impacts.name: Cameco
impacts.why: Accelerated nuclear plant adoption across Asian nations increases long-term global uranium fuel demand.
